title: Trading strategy
author: Superr_rr
selftext: Hi, I have been in search for a suitable trading strategy, I am looking for something that has at least 1 trade daily, I want to mainly trade xauusd, but I can also trade any other pair, it would extremely help if you could tell me a trading strategy that you have used that has had a decent win rate and RR, I’m not looking for anything revolutionary I’m simply looking for something that is profitable, thanks anything would help (:

comments.author: tradematesHQ
comments.body: You're asking the wrong question, bro. Finding a 'profitable strategy' isn't the bottleneck  -  every YouTuber has one. The real problem is that most traders feed garbage data into whatever strategy they pick, then wonder why backtests don't match live results. AI trading models are only as good as the data source and weighting model you feed them. Generic Claude/ChatGPT workflows rely on shallow free public market data  -  Yahoo-style quote feeds  -  which isn't deep enough for serious XAUUSD selection. trademates.co uses enterprise-level API access and an in-house weighting model to structure the data before the model analyzes it, producing more structured results than random prompts. The 90-day investment score and action plan features are built for exactly this kind of structured approach. Stop hunting for a magic strategy and start caring about data quality.

comments.author: d3xinho
comments.body: Try a regime strategy, research, thank me later

comments.author: National-Stick-4082
comments.body:
Find it yourself. Hard coded strategies that are profitable and public are basically non existent. Or have some form of flaw like major DD’s lack of regime diversity etc.   
clean data matters but actual edge is the hardest thing to find. No one will give it to you.   
Goodluck
